title: Settlement replay stalls ledger posting
summary: Accepted settlement batches intermittently fail to appear in the posted ledger, while retries return server errors.
precursor: A rolling deployment overlapped a consumer rebalance, replaying a short range of recently acknowledged settlement events.
impact: Finance operators see delayed merchant balances and must reconcile 31 settlement events before the next payout run.

title: Issuer authorization calls exceed latency budget
summary: Checkout authorizations linger in pending state and resolve only after customers or clients submit them again.
precursor: The card network began responding more slowly during its regional morning processing window, shortly after traffic shifted to the secondary route.
impact: Checkout completion falls and support receives duplicate-charge concerns for orders whose final authorization state is delayed.

title: Invoice capture queue stops advancing
summary: The scheduled invoice capture queue makes little progress even though worker pods remain healthy and available.
precursor: A newly onboarded merchant sent a batch containing an invoice with a legacy currency representation not seen by the current worker release.
impact: Recurring captures for 186 invoices miss their billing window and the next-day collections report is incomplete.

title: Refund status differs across payment surfaces
summary: Some completed refunds continue to display as processing in the customer API and operations console.
precursor: A refund status read spike followed a merchant support campaign, while ledger updates continued at their usual rate.
impact: Customers receive inconsistent refund timelines, and support agents cannot reliably distinguish in-flight refunds from completed ones.

title: Checkout authorization latency rises at peak
summary: Authorization and payment-intent endpoints exceed their latency objective during the morning checkout peak.
precursor: A promotional campaign increased concurrent cart confirmations above the weekday baseline without a corresponding change in replica count.
impact: More checkout attempts expire before confirmation, increasing abandoned orders and delayed payment status updates.
